fields.description: What the rep is asked. A Column Break needs none; a Section Break or Tab Break uses it as the heading.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: Stable key this field is stored and addressed by, and the name a rule targets.
fields.label: Fieldname

fields.description: The control the rep is given. Tab Break, Section Break and Column Break are layout instead of questions: they store nothing and open a new tab, heading or column that the rows below them fall into.
fields.label: Field Type

fields.description: Select: newline-separated options. Link: the target doctype.
fields.label: Options

fields.description: Mandatory on every save. A field required only under a condition is declared under Rules instead.
fields.label: Required

fields.description: Optional condition under which this field is shown, e.g. eval:doc.outcome=='Connected'. Any Rule naming this field replaces what is typed here, so a rule-driven field is left blank.
fields.label: Depends On

fields.description: Compiled from the type's rules and not typed here. It carries the condition under which the field is required, and a hidden field is never required.
fields.label: Mandatory Depends On

fields.description: Whose record the value belongs to. Activity is answered by the rep and stored on the task; Lead is read from the patient record, shown read-only, and snapshotted as it stood that day.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: The storage shape this answer is filed into, declared once on CRM Task Section. Left blank, the answer is filed in the answers store.
fields.label: Section

fields.description: The column the answer occupies — a column of the Section's DocType, or a settable CRM Task column when no Section is named. Left blank, the answer is stored under its own fieldname.
fields.label: Target
Automation: Watchable
fields.description: A change to this field may fire a workflow, which is meaningful only where the field names a Target column.
